newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Japanese Emperor Akihito arrives in Brasilia.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Emperor Akihito arrives in Brasilia.

text.p: Emperor Akihito and Empress Michiko of Japan arrived Monday in the Brazilian capital Brasilia, the second stop on a two-week official visit to South America, an airport official said.
They were scheduled to meet later in the day with President Fernando Henrique Cardoso and on Tuesday with members of the Japanese community in Brasilia.
Akihito, the first Japanese emperor to visit South America, is due to fly to Buenos Aires June 9 for a three-day visit to Argentina.
The Japanese imperial couple started their visit to Brazil on Sunday with a boat trip near the mouth of the Amazon River.
